tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Coverings of Simply Connected Spaces] 1. chA:A.59[LeeTM, Cor. 11.33] If $M$ is a simply connected manifold with or without boundary, then every covering of $M$ is a homeomorphism, and if $M$ is smooth, every smooth covering is a diffeomorphism.
